integrity: Analytic proof and exact-rational reproduction code supplied; no independent scientific audit has been performed, and historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Fixed in-degree classes under the independent uniform self-map law only; limits are covariance limits, not joint distributional convergence, and fixed-degree asymptotic signs do not imply finite-size signs. Earlier broad mapping-statistics methods can contain implicit consequences.
title: A Poisson second-difference law for component–indegree covariance in random mappings
